workload: synthetic adapter contracts and committed between-query writer races on restricted PostgreSQL connections; no real evaluation or latency claim

probes.name: restricted login cannot read labels, normalized evidence or raw manifests, or write derived values
lagged features alone reproduce hand probabilities and expose research, clocks, versions and lineage
2, 8 and 16 observations keep the same three-statement/two-rights budget
unknown request versions and malformed inputs refuse before SQL
stored unknown versions cannot be reinterpreted as the supported version
real database knowledge clocks have inclusive as-of selection without backdating
strict and retrospective feature versions remain distinct; no synthetic clock is backdated
missing features, one-game history and unavailable features have explicit tagged refusals
materialized history rejects malformed, noninteger, duplicate and mismatched rows
target, equal-cutoff and future events refuse identically in both evidence modes
one microsecond before the event cutoff is accepted in both modes
pinned values survive corrections with current superseded and stale flags
current rights refusals return no derived values or lineage
expired superseding grants and revocations never revive an older research grant
pre-cancellation and an expired request deadline send no query and keep the connection reusable
an in-flight query timeout terminates the connection and returns a discard refusal
in-flight caller cancellation terminates the query connection without a follow-up SQL statement
committed research revocation at either read boundary withholds delivery
committed source deletion at either read boundary removes the selected feature and withholds delivery
delivery refuses lineage attached after authorization instead of widening its authorization
pruned exact versions refuse before or during delivery and never fall back to a newer version
a revocation after the final snapshot illustrates the accepted delivery gap; the next request refuses
the absolute request deadline interrupts a query even without a pg query timeout
